name: web-billboard-with-three-frosted-panels-payments-cards-and-app
title: Roadside billboard of three pearl panels: a '85%' bars message, refractive cards and a download-app phone
whatItIs: A billboard on a concrete-slat frame beside trees showing three light frosted panels: a black logo tile with 'Smarter Payments for Everyday Life.' with an orange keyword and a big 85% over white bars, a panel of iridescent translucent payment cards with 'Experience the Future of Finance.', and a panel with 'Download the App', store badges and a phone.
whatItMeans: Airy and modern; pearly panels look premium against a rough street setting.
techniques: Split a billboard into three panels with one message each.

vocabulary.definition: A billboard divided into three panels.
A translucent card with rainbow highlights.
One word coloured differently in a headline.
